_meta.note: Structural regression golden. All 4 endpoints switched from a local 529-only withRetry to callClaudeWithRetry (parse-retry + truncation fail-fast). 21 annotation leaks stripped from primary output (caption text/tone, hashtag.tag, platform_name badge) — check:golden checks STRUCTURE not content, eyeball wording after prompt edits. adapt max_tokens 2000->3000 (adaptations scale with target count). Re-locked 2026-08-23 (v2): posting_schedule removed and hashtag categories dropped. Best-posting-times named days, hours and a rationale nothing retrieved, and a hashtag labelled trending is a claim about post volume nobody counted. not_sure_about is new — the list of visual details the captions are forbidden to assert. Re-locked 2026-08-23 (v3): not_sure_about is now empty for any request with no image, enforced in code. Uncertainty here comes from looking; a typed description contains only facts the person supplied, and listing one as uncertain then blocked the fact they gave us. This case is description-only, so an empty array is the correct output rather than a regression. Re-locked 2026-08-23 (v4): the main endpoint is now four stages, not one — observe (vision, image) → generate (NO IMAGE) → validate (NO IMAGE, adversarial) → repair only the fields that failed. image_read and not_sure_about are gone, replaced by observed[] and uncertain[]; prohibited_inferences is envelope scaffolding and is stripped before the response. The reason for the rewrite is that not_sure_about was prose: the model wrote an accurate list and contradicted it in the next field, through four prompt rewrites. Withholding the image from stage 2 is what makes it a mechanism rather than another instruction. Stage 3 logs PASS/FAIL on every call because a validator that has stopped working returns the same empty list as one that found nothing — scripts/caption-magic-envelope-test.js plants known violations to tell those apart, and is run BY HAND (two live calls), never in the hook. Validation is fail-open: it wraps a working answer and must never be able to drop it. Re-locked 2026-08-23 (v5): the tool was over-explaining its work instead of doing its job. why_it_works, best_for, tone labels, engagement_tips, avoid, posting schedule and the A/B panel are all gone — the visitor can tell whether they like a joke, and explaining one makes it worse. Three captions became six across a deliberate range (straightforward → warm → clever → dry → playful → wild card), given as generation instructions and never shown as labels. Tone is no longer a control: the six span it. Remix is replaced by /caption-magic/more (funnier / unhinged / warmer / drier / surprise / six more), which takes the envelope back from the client so the new six stay grounded in the same reading of the photograph rather than a fresh vision call. observed/uncertain moved under `envelope` because the whole envelope now round-trips. revise directions are more_like_this / shorter / punch_up. The old remix-de case is replaced by more-de.

captions.text: Ich starte ein Freelance-Schreibgeschäft. Das Notizbuch weiß noch nichts davon.
Das Notizbuch ist leer. Der Kaffee wird kalt. Ich habe einen Plan, der wahrscheinlich nicht funktioniert.
Irgendwann werde ich verstehen, dass ein Notizbuch und Kaffee nicht ausreichen. Aber jetzt noch nicht.
Das ist der Moment, in dem ich so tue, als würde ich wissen, was kommt. Ich wollte ein Foto davon machen.
Alle werden mir später erzählen, dass dies der Anfang war — und ich werde so tun, als hätte ich es die ganze Zeit gewusst.
Das Notizbuch wird bald sehr voll sein. Der Kaffee wird bald sehr kalt sein.
